description: This figure presents four pie charts, each representing the distribution of response types for different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart contains between two and five slices. The GPT4-o chart has two slices, labeled “Safety” (pink, 16.7%) and “Lack of Knowledge” (orange, 83.3%). The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has four slices, labeled “Safety” (pink, 9.3%), “Lack of Knowledge” (blue, 22.1%), “Ethical Advice” (light blue, 16.3%), and “Misinformation” (coral, 38.4%). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has two slices, labeled “Clarification” (orange, 12.5%) and “Lack of Knowledge” (coral, 75.0%). Finally, the Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart has two slices, labeled “Lack of Knowledge” (coral, 50.0%) and “Misinformation” (orange, 50.0%). Each chart includes percentage labels displayed inside the slices, and a legend is not present. The slices in each chart do not appear to be ordered in any particular way.
